'''Grathrax Bring him before me.....''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Grathrax]]
* '''Published:''' 25 April 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 BHBM Grathrax DS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Imperial Reinforcements (V), Probe Droid (V), The Emperor (V), IG-88 (V), Boba Fett (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

*Updated to a Bring him before me....

The published list has 50 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 50 as published: the post lists only 50 cards (Effects and Characters sections have no counts).
* Oppressive Enforcement and There Is No Try in the starting section dested the Effects (Special Edition / Dagobah), not the Reflections III shields; Mobilization Points dested the single Death Star II Effect; Throne Room dested Death Star II: Throne Room.
* Takeel x2 is listed under Interrupts; dested the card Takeel as posted.
* Posted Bossk w/Gun dested Bossk With Mortar Gun; Colonel Davon Jon dested Colonel Davod Jon.
* Original-era (V) cards: Imperial Reinforcements (V) (Virtual Set 2), Probe Droid (V) (Virtual Set 4), IG-88 (V) (Virtual Set 5), The Emperor (V) and Boba Fett (V) (Virtual Set 6).

== Strategy ==

Get the emperor onto the death star.  Send Vader out after luke, then throw down the generic docking bay at whatever planet he is on, if there already isnt one there.  Your eyes can be deceiving will not allow opponent to see what he is losing to Your Destiny.  Mara Jade and IG88 (V) (immune to attrition <7 with emperor)  can protect the emperor from spies and such if need be.  Probe Droids (V) can be used to break into the enemy sites and wreak havoc there.  Use the death star II docking bay (or other docking bays) to build up a fleet hidden base style and then unleash it upon the enemy, this actually worked well for me.  Mobilization points means lots of force generation for me. Im trying to get rise, my friend, were in attack posistion now and another vader.
